description: brainstorm-toolkit — surface the .next-action seam + keep long loops context-cheap. The Stop hook surfaces /brainstorm handoffs, /sdlc-lite --queue park-resumes, and gotcha seams as `Next: …` (and, with pipeline.auto_continue, drives the loop). The SessionStart hook (matcher compact|clear) reseeds a pointer to the loop's durable on-disk state after a compaction/clear, so aggressive auto-compaction stays lossless for the orchestrator. Merges with any user/project hooks (deduped by command). See docs/SEAM.md and docs/LOOP-HYGIENE.md.
